Raj: Heads-up — Acadia Labs asked for a temporary bulk-seat rate for a 3-month pilot: 500 developer seats. They're requesting 40% off list and want an invoice before pilot start. Need finance signoff to proceed.
Nico: Quick context: expected ACV ~$120k if they convert. Pilot start 2026-04-15. They prefer net30 invoicing. Historically we capped pilot credits ~20k for similar accounts.
Tess: @Maya can you confirm the pilot credit cap? Also need GL code and whether prepay is required for anything above the cap.
Maya: We typically allow up to $15k one-off credits for SMB pilots w/o exec signoff. 40% on 500 seats exceeds that. Possible structure: 20% off first 3 months + a 12-month minimum on conversion. If they prepay, we can flex.
Raj: Customer said they'd prepay 3 months if we give 30% off. They need a firm yes by EOD tomorrow and want invoice labelled 'Pilot Discount — Acadia Labs'.
Tess: Proposed terms from RevOps side: 30% off first 3 months with a hard cap of $25k, invoice net15, and a $10k conversion credit if they convert to a paid plan within 6 months. Condition: RevOps needs the CRM commit flag and a signed addendum attached. GL code required.
Maya: I can approve 30% up to $25k cap provided legal signs the addendum and RevOps verifies CRM commit. Finance will generate the credit note after invoice posts. @Nico attach the signed addendum to the deal. This is a one-off.
Nico: Will chase legal and get the signed addendum today. Which billing SKU should we use for the invoice: `dev-seat-pilot` or `seat-smb-pilot`?
Tess: Use `seat-smb-pilot`. I'll create discount line item DISC-PILOT-30 and map to GL 4002. Process: 1) Create invoice net15 for pilot, 2) apply discount line item (cap enforced), 3) if they convert, apply conversion CN.
billing-bot: Created credit note CN-8142 for Acadia Labs (cap $25,000) and linked to invoice INV-20260415-ACD. Status: pending approval.
Maya: Finance sign-off: approved CN-8142 up to $25k cap. Approval note: Maya (Finance). Please mark this as a one-time concession — do not set a precedent. :thumbsup:
Raj: Great — thanks all. I'll confirm with Acadia, tell them the 30% up to $25k, ask for prepay instructions, and attach the signed addendum once received. :tada:
